tunnelSettings.title: Remote access
tunnelSettings.subtitle: Expose this gateway on the internet so the mobile app can connect from anywhere. Off by default for your security.
tunnelSettings.needToken: Sign in to the gateway (valid token) to manage remote access.
tunnelSettings.riskBannerBody: Remote access exposes your gateway on the public internet. Only enable when you understand the risks.
tunnelSettings.consentExpiredBanner: The remote access security notice was updated. Re-confirm before starting the tunnel or enabling auto-start.
tunnelSettings.startProgressHint: First start can take 1–3 minutes (HTTPS certificate). The public URL appears before the tunnel is fully ready.
tunnelSettings.publicUrlPendingNotice: Public URL is assigned. Finish the remaining steps before using it remotely.
tunnelSettings.stepRegisterDetail: Public URL assigned — HTTPS and frp connection still in progress
tunnelSettings.stepTlsDetail: Requesting TLS certificate for your subdomain
tunnelSettings.stepTlsDnsPropagation: Waiting for DNS propagation (can take 1–2 minutes)
tunnelSettings.stepFrpcDetail: Waiting for frpc login (up to 60 seconds)
tunnelSettings.lanHint: For LAN + tunnel QR, set gateway host to 0.0.0.0 in Gateway settings.
tunnelSettings.pairSubtitle: Scan with your mobile app. The app exchanges a one-time pairing key for your gateway token.
tunnelSettings.pairTunnelActive: Remote access is on. The QR includes your tunnel URL, LAN address when available, and a one-time pairing key.
tunnelSettings.pairBaseUrlHint: Use an address reachable from your phone (for example LAN IP and port). This may differ from the address in your desktop browser.
tunnelSettings.pairLocalhostWarning: This URL looks like localhost. Phones on the network cannot reach your machine unless you expose the gateway (for example bind to LAN and use http://<this-machine-ip>:<port>).
tunnelSettings.pairSecurityNote: The QR contains a one-time pairing key (valid 5 minutes, single use). Only show it where you trust the people and cameras around you.
tunnelSettings.pairImageError: Could not generate a QR image. Copy the pairing link instead.
tunnelSettings.pairSchemeHint: Format registered by apps: xopc://gateway/mobile-connect?baseUrl=…&ps=… (exchange ps for token via POST /api/tunnel/exchange-token)
tunnelSettings.pairInvalidBaseUrl: Enter an absolute gateway URL starting with http:// or https:// (no path required).
tunnelSettings.releaseHint: Revokes the subdomain on the broker. Your next start will get a new public URL.
tunnelSettings.releaseConfirmBody: This deregisters the tunnel on frp.xopc.ai and clears saved credentials. You will get a new subdomain when you start remote access again.
tunnelSettings.autoStartHint: Available after you start remote access once and accept the security notice.
tunnelSettings.autoStartConfirmTitle: Start tunnel on every gateway launch?
tunnelSettings.autoStartConfirmBody: Your gateway will be reachable from the internet whenever it runs. Only enable if you accept that risk.
tunnelSettings.consentIntro: Read carefully before exposing your gateway:
tunnelSettings.consentBullet1: A public URL lets anyone who obtains it use your gateway Bearer token.
tunnelSettings.consentBullet2: Traffic is proxied via frp.xopc.ai (third-party infrastructure).
tunnelSettings.consentBullet3: Use a strong token; stop the tunnel when you do not need remote access.
tunnelSettings.consentCheckbox: I understand these risks and want to enable remote access
tunnelSettings.brokerNote: Traffic is proxied via frp.xopc.ai. Keep your gateway token private. See docs/tunnel-security.md.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretHint: Required to register with frp.xopc.ai. Stored in xopc.json on this machine.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretEnvHint: XOPC_TUNNEL_REGISTRATION_SECRET is set in the environment and overrides the value below.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretPlaceholderKeep: Leave blank to keep saved secret
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretMissingHint: Set the registration secret here or export XOPC_TUNNEL_REGISTRATION_SECRET before starting remote access.
tunnelSettings.e2eSubtitle: Local TLS terminator used before frp forwards traffic (tunnel.e2e).
tunnelSettings.e2eEnabledHint: When off, tunnel HTTPS provisioning is skipped.
tunnelSettings.e2eTlsPortHint: Port for the on-machine HTTPS listener. Suggested default: {{port}} (gateway port + 1).
tunnelSettings.e2eStagingHint: For testing certificate issuance without production rate limits.
tunnelSettings.e2eRestartHint: E2E TLS port changes require stopping remote access and restarting the gateway.
tunnelSettings.e2eConnectedWarning: Remote access is active. Stop the tunnel before changing TLS port or E2E options.
